Execution history supports status/start filters and replay using either the original workflow or the currently saved workflow with previous execution data.
Wait steps support time intervals, specified times and webhook/form resume conditions.
Official documentation describes branching workflows with Paths. Foundly does not claim comparable visual branching coverage.
Saving keeps edits in draft; explicit publication pins production execution to a version. Publishing another version and unpublishing are supported.

capabilities.foundly_current: Sequential durable steps, conditions, delays, owner-bound schedules, exact approval and bounded transient retries for adapter-proven idempotent internal tasks/documents. Lost-response retries reuse the same durable owned record; exhausted retries remain in DEAD_LETTER history. Shared authoring contracts now drive a sequential editor with ordered steps, typed per-step conditions, explicit scheduling, approvals and retries; compiled definitions pass engine and authenticated encrypted-restart tests. Owner-scoped activation now selects one immutable version or pauses the group, with optimistic revision checks, canonical transition events and retained pending runs. Exact persisted internal task/document outcomes can now reconcile interrupted result capture, followed by a separately requested continuation. Original actor, request, step definition and record fingerprints are checked; missing or external proof stays blocked.
capabilities.gap: Visual branching/grouped-condition editing, separate autosaved drafts, recovery without a proven internal result and searchable debugging remain incomplete. Browser acceptance is blocked.
capabilities.required_change: Complete debugging and original workflow authoring breadth; external outcome recovery requires legitimate provider verification contracts.
capabilities.foundly_differentiator: Candidate: shared Core identity, provenance and ZERO tools. Comparative superiority is not proven.
